bonus feature discussed below (to specify valid sequences of moves in a single round)
Alternatively, we could draw the moves with arrows pointing from the piece to possible target
locations. But this is harder, because it does not specify what other pieces must/must not be on the
board (when one diagram represents multiple possible moves). I think we do not want that.
When a regular piece is in a special
area defined in INITIAL board state,
it becomes a different kind of piece
Definitions of possible combinations of moves [OPTIONAL]
Depending on the variation of the game, different moves can happen in a single round. It can be
single REGULAR move, a sequence of any number REGULAR_JUMP moves, sequence of any number
of single particular KING moves (they can go arbitrary distance but not change direction). We can
label the arrows to distinguish what exactly moves are legal.
